card.name: Linking words before opioid drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation such as 'of', 'in', 'e.g.,', commas and 'such as' that come right before an opioid drug name is expected, in opioid warning text.

modes.label: 'of' before product name
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'during the use' in the respiratory depression warning, just before an opioid product name.
modes.example: can occur at any time during the use<< of>> Codeine Sulfate Tablets, the

modes.label: List punctuation before an opioid
modes.description: A comma, 'e.g.,' or bracket in a list of opioids, just before the next opioid is named.
modes.example: Concomitant use of opioid drugs (e.g<<.,>> meperidine and its derivatives, meth

modes.label: 'in' or 'as' before an opioid
modes.description: A short linking word that leads into an opioid name such as oxycodone or butalbital.
modes.example: may result in an increase<< in>> oxycodone plasma concentration. Monitor

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with opioid and morphine-type names and pain words.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before an opioid drug name is likely to appear.
